# sol.new

> sol.new is the fastest way for everyday people to create tokens, NFTs, wallets, payments, and DAOs on Solana. Wallets are secured by passkeys (Face ID / Touch ID) — no seed phrases, no installs, no signup. It runs entirely in the browser as a progressive web app.

## What you can do on sol.new

- [Create a Token](https://sol.new/token): Launch your own SPL token / Solana memecoin in seconds. Upload an image, pick a name and symbol, and go live instantly. Low fees.
- [Mint an NFT](https://sol.new/nft): Turn any image into an NFT on Solana — standard or compressed (cNFT).
- [Multisig](https://sol.new/multisig): Create shared wallets with multiple required signers for couples, teams, and DAOs.
- [Wallet](https://sol.new/wallet): A passkey-secured Solana wallet. Get SOL, send payments, and manage tokens and NFTs.
- [Get SOL](https://sol.new/get): Fund a wallet with Apple Pay, Google Pay, or a card — no exchange account needed.
- [Payment Links](https://sol.new/pay): Create a Solana Pay link or QR anyone can pay with, in SOL or USDC.
- [Split a Bill](https://sol.new/split): Split a bill or invoice between friends and get paid in SOL or USDC. Add a tip, set the number of people, and share a link or QR per person with paid-tracking.
- [Track a Wallet](https://sol.new/track): Paste any Solana address to view its tokens, NFTs, and balances.
- [Portfolio](https://sol.new/portfolio): See your Solana tokens, NFTs, and balances in one place.

## Content

- [What's New](https://sol.new/whats-new): The newest tokens launched on sol.new, in real time.
- [News](https://sol.new/news): Latest Solana and crypto headlines, aggregated from top sources.
- [Podcasts](https://sol.new/pods): Hand-picked Solana and crypto podcasts.
- [Docs & Guides](https://sol.new/docs): How to create tokens, mint NFTs, set up multisig, and accept payments.
- [Compare](https://sol.new/compare): How sol.new compares to pump.fun, Bags, and Bonk.

## Key facts

- Network: Solana (mainnet and devnet).
- Security: passkey-based (WebAuthn) wallets — no seed phrases to lose.
- Access: no install and no signup required; works in any modern browser and installs as a PWA.
- Token launch fee: 1%.
- Links: X/Twitter https://x.com/soldotnew · Telegram https://t.me/soldotnew
